$schema: DevNotes — deviations, discoveries, decisions captured during build

notes.content: Plan called for `git mv` to relocate effects/ and components/ into public/modules/, but apps/scene-engine/public/assets/** is gitignored (the .gitignore rule `assets/` matches with no exception for the new public path). Used plain `mv` instead — no git history to preserve since the files were never tracked. Also extended .gitignore with exceptions for `apps/scene-engine/public/assets/**` and `apps/scene-engine/public/modules/**` so the new structure is tracked going forward.

Plan said `media/` contained two .mp4 files (test-fire-2, test-fire-3) — actual contents had a third (test-fire.mp4) not referenced by registry. Moved all three to video/ for consistency. Extra file is now a candidate for the inspector swap dropdown in CP3.

CanvasPanel.tsx (drop handler buildLayer) also imported the removed RegistryEntry type and dispatched on entry.type === 'media' / 'glyph-group'. Updated buildLayer to switch on the new asset/module union types: 'video'/'image' both build a media-style layer, 'glyph' builds a glyph-group layer (asset-type vs layer-type distinction), 'audio'/'effect'/'component' unchanged. Removed default branch since the union is now exhaustive.
app/scenes/[id]/page.tsx (scene preview) also called loadRegistry('/assets/registry.json') — wasn't listed in the plan but had to be updated to the no-arg signature so TS compile succeeds.

The new app/api/assets/[type]/ route directory was caught by the global `assets/` .gitignore rule. Extended .gitignore with `!apps/scene-engine/app/api/assets/` + `**` exceptions so the route file is tracked. (Same flavor of issue as CP1 task 1.1.1, but for the API route rather than public/.)
